claims: The 152nd Kentucky Derby is scheduled for Saturday, May 2, 2026.
The 152nd Kentucky Derby is at Churchill Downs in Louisville, KY.
The 152nd Kentucky Derby post time is expected around 6:57 p.m. ET.
As of April 2026, Commandment and Further Ado lead the points standings.
Commandment is trained by Brad Cox.
Further Ado is trained by Brad Cox.
Renegade is trained by Todd Pletcher.
Kentucky Oaks is on Friday, May 1, 2026.
Further Ado is winner of April 4 Blue Grass Stakes.
Renegade is winner of Arkansas Derby.
The Kentucky Derby features a $2 million purse.
The Kentucky Oaks offers $1.5 million purse.
Official Derby Experiences packages are available for the 2026 event.
As of April 11, 2026, Renegade has 4-1 odds and is the favorite.
As of April 11, 2026, Commandment has 7-1 odds.
As of April 11, 2026, The Puma has 12-1 odds.
As of April 11, 2026, Chief Wallabee has 13-1 odds.
The field of 20 horses is finalized based on the Road to the Kentucky Derby points system.
